entries.subject: Size: estimate from the JPL Horizons magnitude and an assumed albedo
entries.finding: Iocaste is drawn as a sphere of about 8.4 km diameter (radius 4.2 km), estimated from the apparent magnitude JPL Horizons gives for body 524 (22.14 on 2026-Sep-03, H = 14.5 with no phase term) and an assumed geometric albedo of 0.04. The size is not measured, and ignoring the phase term slightly understates it.
